description: Generate carousel slide images, package them as a LinkedIn-ready PDF, and optionally attach it to a post. Pass reference_bindings to preserve official identity/product/brand truth separately from inspiration used only for style/layout. Slide copy should follow the source post structure when relevant while rephrasing for clearer, more emotional visual impact instead of repeating the post verbatim. For data-backed decks, pass source_urls/research_notes or run bamf.run_research first; visible data must be source-backed. If likenessReferenceImageUrls is omitted, BAMF uses the creator avatar/LinkedIn profile image as the default likeness reference.

likenessReferenceImageUrls.description: Optional creator likeness references. Defaults to the creator avatar/LinkedIn profile image when omitted.

post_id.description: Optional draft/scheduled post to attach the generated PDF to.

reference_bindings.description: Resolved bamf.multimodal-reference-binding/v1 envelopes. Each item contains binding plus asset_url; official and inspiration authority is validated before the job is persisted.

asset_url.description: HTTPS URL for the immutable asset version named by the binding.

binding.description: A complete bamf.multimodal-reference-binding/v1 object with consent and provenance.

research_notes.description: Concise source-backed facts to use only when they strengthen the slides.

source_urls.description: Source URLs for slide claims or benchmark facts.

visual_copy_strategy.description: Guidance for additive slide copy that improves on the post instead of copying it.

name: bamf.generate_carousel
